```{r}
save_plot = function(plot, file, legend = TRUE, width = 4, height = 4, png = FALSE, svg = FALSE) {
  if (png) { ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".png"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in') }
  if (svg) { ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".svg"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in') }
  ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".pdf"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in')
}
```

# Prepare PBMC data.
```{r}
seu_pbmcs_annotated = readRDS("rds_objects/6_pbmcs_harmonized.rds")
seu_pbmcs_annotated$CHIP[seu_pbmcs_annotated$Patient_ID == "CH-21-006"] = "DNMT3A"
seu_pbmcs_annotated$CHIP[seu_pbmcs_annotated$Patient_ID == "CH-21-014"] = "TET2"
seu_pbmcs_annotated$CHIP[seu_pbmcs_annotated$CHIP == "control"] = "Control"

```

# Prepare adipose data.
```{r}
seu_adipose_annotated = readRDS("rds_objects/5_annotated_adipose.rds")
seu_adipose_annotated$Patient_ID = seu_adipose_annotated$HATIMID
seu_adipose_annotated$cell_type = gsub("\\/", " and ", seu_adipose_annotated$cell_type)

```


# Merge monocytes and endothelial cells.
```{r}
endothelial = subset(seu_adipose_annotated, subset = (cell_type == "Endothelial"))
cd14_monos = subset(seu_pbmcs_annotated, subset = (cell_type == "Classical Monocytes"))

mono_endo = merge(endothelial, cd14_monos)
```

# Merge T cells and endothelial cells.
```{r}
endothelial = subset(seu_adipose_annotated, subset = (cell_type == "Endothelial"))
t_cells = subset(seu_pbmcs_annotated, subset = (cell_type %in% c("CD8+ NKT-like cells", "Naive CD4+ T cells")))

t_endo = merge(endothelial, t_cells)
```


# Function to create objects.
```{r}
create_cc = function(seu_obj, output_path, secreted_only = FALSE) {
  cellchat = createCellChat(object = seu_obj, meta = seu_obj@meta.data, group.by = "cell_type") 
  CellChatDB = CellChatDB.human
  
  if (secreted_only) {
    CellChatDB.use = subsetDB(CellChatDB, search = "Secreted Signaling")
  } else {
    CellChatDB.use = CellChatDB
  }
  cellchat@DB = CellChatDB.use

  cellchat = subsetData(cellchat)
  cellchat = identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
  cellchat = identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat) 
  cellchat = projectData(cellchat, PPI.human) 
  cellchat = computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = 'truncatedMean') 
  cellchat = filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 25) 
  cellchat = computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat) 
  cellchat = aggregateNet(cellchat)
  cellchat = netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat, slot.name = "netP")

  saveRDS(cellchat, output_path)
  return(cellchat)
}

```

# Merge objects and run cellchat.
```{r}
merged.list = SplitObject(mono_endo, split.by = "CHIP")

merged_tet2 = merged.list$TET2
merged_dnmt3a = merged.list$DNMT3A
merged_control = merged.list$Control

create_cc(merged_tet2, "rds_objects/cellchat/adipose_pbmc_tet2_cc.rds")
create_cc(merged_dnmt3a, "rds_objects/cellchat/adipose_pbmc_dnmt3a_cc.rds")
create_cc(merged_control, "rds_objects/cellchat/adipose_pbmc_control_cc.rds")

```

# Create T cell cellchat object.
```{r}
t_endo_merged.list = SplitObject(t_endo, split.by = "CHIP")

t_endo_merged_tet2 = t_endo_merged.list$TET2
t_endo_merged_dnmt3a = t_endo_merged.list$DNMT3A
```

# Load objects.
```{r}
adipose_pbmc_tet2_cc = readRDS("rds_objects/cellchat/adipose_pbmc_tet2_cc.rds")
adipose_pbmc_dnmt3a_cc = readRDS("rds_objects/cellchat/adipose_pbmc_dnmt3a_cc.rds")
adipose_pbmc_control_cc = readRDS("rds_objects/cellchat/adipose_pbmc_control_cc.rds")
```

# Merge objects.
```{r}
adipose_pbmc_cc.list = list(TET2 = adipose_pbmc_tet2_cc, DNMT3A = adipose_pbmc_dnmt3a_cc, Control = adipose_pbmc_control_cc)
adipose_pbmc_cc = mergeCellChat(adipose_pbmc_cc.list, add.names = names(adipose_pbmc_cc.list))
adipose_pbmc_cc = updateCellChat(adipose_pbmc_cc)
```

```{r}
write_tsv(adipose_pbmc_cc@netP["TET2"]$TET2$prob %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("source"), "tables/cellchat/tet2_probabilities.tsv")
write_tsv(adipose_pbmc_cc@netP["DNMT3A"]$DNMT3A$prob %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("source"), "tables/cellchat/dnmt3a_probabilities.tsv")
write_tsv(adipose_pbmc_cc@netP["Control"]$Control$prob %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("source"), "tables/cellchat/control_probabilities.tsv")

```

# Monocyte <--> endothelial cell signaling.
```{r}

(mono_endo_grouped_rank = rankNet(adipose_pbmc_cc, mode = "comparison", comparison = c(1, 2, 3), sources.use = c("Classical Monocytes", "Endothelial"), targets.use = c("Classical Monocytes", "Endothelial"), signaling = c("CCL", "ICAM", "VCAM", "SELPLG", "CXCL", "SELL", "ITGB2", "PECAM1"), do.stat = TRUE, color.use = c("#3E7274",  "#584482", "grey")) + aes(x = contribution.scaled, y = name) + ylab("") + xlab("Signaling strength") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))) 
write_tsv(mono_endo_grouped_rank$data, "tables/cellchat/mono_endo_ranknet_results.tsv")


save_plot(mono_endo_grouped_rank, "figures/cellchat/rank_mono_endo_grouped", width = 4, height = 3, svg = TRUE)

```

```{r}
ligand_receptors = CellChatDB.human[["interaction"]] %>% filter(pathway_name == "ICAM") %>% select(ligand, receptor) %>% as.vector() %>% unlist() %>% unique()

# Extract normalized expression (can also use "RNA" or "SCT" depending on your assay)
expr_matrix <- FetchData(mono_endo, vars = ligand_receptors)

# Select metadata columns of interest
metadata_subset <- mono_endo@meta.data[, c("cell_type", "CHIP")]

# Combine expression and metadata
combined_matrix <- cbind(metadata_subset, expr_matrix)

# Identify gene columns
gene_cols <- setdiff(colnames(combined_matrix), c("cell_type", "CHIP"))

# Group by cell_type and CHIP, then summarize non-zero counts for each gene
grouped_counts <- combined_matrix %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(gene_cols), ~sum(.x != 0), .names = "nonzero_{.col}"))

sum(grouped_counts[1, ] < 50) / ncol(grouped_counts)
```



# Check T cells.
```{r}
t_endo_tet2_cc = readRDS("rds_objects/cellchat/t_endo_tet2_cc.rds")
t_endo_dnmt3a_cc = readRDS("rds_objects/cellchat/t_endo_dnmt3a_cc.rds")
t_endo_control_cc = readRDS("rds_objects/cellchat/t_endo_control_cc.rds")

t_endo_cc.list = list(TET2 = t_endo_tet2_cc, DNMT3A = t_endo_dnmt3a_cc, Control = t_endo_control_cc)
t_endo_cc = mergeCellChat(t_endo_cc.list, add.names = names(t_endo_cc.list))
t_endo_cc = updateCellChat(t_endo_cc)
```
# Plot T cell signaling
```{r}
(t_endo_grouped_rank = rankNet(t_endo_cc, mode = "comparison", comparison = c(1, 2, 3), sources.use = c("CD8+ NKT-like cells", "Endothelial"), targets.use = c("CD8+ NKT-like cells", "Endothelial"), signaling = c("IFN-I", "IFN-II"), do.stat = TRUE, color.use = c("#3E7274",  "#584482", "grey")) + aes(x = contribution.scaled, y = name) + ylab("") + xlab("Signaling strength") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + ggtitle("CD8+ T cells"))

(t_endo_grouped_rank = rankNet(t_endo_cc, mode = "comparison", comparison = c(1, 2, 3), sources.use = c("Naive CD4+ T cells", "Endothelial"), targets.use = c("Naive CD4+ T cells", "Endothelial"), signaling = c("IFN-I", "IFN-II"), do.stat = TRUE, color.use = c("#3E7274",  "#584482", "grey")) + aes(x = contribution.scaled, y = name) + ylab("") + xlab("Signaling strength") +
```
